_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: S1000D Project Business Rules Exchange (BREX) File
summary: Describes the S1000D Project Business Rules Exchange (BREX) XML file used by the Government program manager to validate and verify a Technical Manual's conformance to the S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table.
use_relationship:
The S1000D Project Business Rules Exchange (BREX) file provides the Government program manager with an eXtensible markup (XML) file.  The S1000D Project BREX file shall be used to validate and verify the conformance of the Technical Manual (TM) to the S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table provided as GFI.

This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.

S1000D referenced in this DID, can be obtained at www.s1000d.org.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of any documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The S1000D Project BREX file shall be presented as specified in S1000D BREX XML data module schema, S1000D Chapter 4.10.2 "Business rules exchange; The BREX data module".

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The S1000D Project Level BREX file shall include S1000D Project Level BREX file labeling identifying the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number
TMCR number, TM identification number(s), and title(s) of the TM(s) covered by the S1000D Project Level BREX
S1000D Project Level Business Rules Decision Table issue date
The name of the issuing Government activity
Submittal date for the S1000D Project BREX file

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements
preparation_instructions.content: The S1000D Project BREX file shall be electronic XML file as specified in S1000D, Chapter 4.10 (Information Management - Business Rules Exchange).
